items.name: amulet of yendor
items.desc: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful artifact known to human or dwarf kind. Its shimmering crystals contain incredible and wondrous power.

items.name: ankh
items.desc: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Most items will be dropped where you died, but can be reclaimed if you return to it. Using a full waterskin, the ankh can be blessed with extra strength.

items.name: arcane resin
items.desc:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are _overridden by other upgrade sources_ however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.

items.name: broken seal
items.desc:
A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle.

A memento from his home, the seal helps the warrior persevere. While wearing the seal the warrior will instantly gain shielding when he is about to be damaged to half health or lower.

The seal can be _affixed to armor,_ and moved between armors. It can carry a single upgrade with it, so long as that upgrade was applied to the armor while the seal was attached to it.

items.name: dewdrop
items.desc:
A crystal clear dewdrop.

Due to the magic of this place, pure water has minor restorative properties.

items.name: energy crystal
items.desc:
A collection of small magical crystals, filled with alchemical energy.

These crystals are the most common ingredient in alchemy recipes and can be produced at an alchemy pot by scrapping consumable items.

items.name: gold
items.desc: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.

items.name: honeypot
items.desc: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.

items.name: Dwarf King's crown
items.desc:
The crown of the last dwarven king, it glows with tremendous magical energy.

When worn, the crown's magic will flow into the armor you're currently wearing, transforming it into a _unique epic armor with special abilities._ The new armor will keep all the properties of the original armor.

items.name: liquid metal
items.desc:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.

items.name: lost backpack
items.desc: This is your lost inventory. Collect it to reclaim all the items you lost!

items.name: repair kit
items.desc: A small box of rivets, wire, patches, oil and a little hammer. Using it restores _50% durability_ to one weapon or piece of armor, even a broken one.

items.name: arcane stylus
items.desc: This arcane stylus is made of some dark, very hard stone. Using it you can inscribe a magical glyph on your armor, but you have no power over choosing what glyph it will be, the stylus will decide it for you.

items.name: Tengu's mask
items.desc:
This mask fell off Tengu's face as he died, you can feel great magical power emanating from it. Was the mask Tengu's source of strength?

When worn, the tremendous power of the mask will be transferred into you, enabling you to _choose a subclass for your hero._

Which subclass will you choose?

items.name: tome of unlearning
items.desc: A heavy purple tome filled with exercises for forgetting bad habits. Reading it refunds every skill point you have spent in one weapon family, so you can spend them again.

items.name: torch
items.desc: An adventuring staple, when a dungeon goes dark, a torch can help lead the way.

items.name: waterskin
items.desc: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.

items.name: arcane bomb
items.desc: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing _X-X magical damage_ to anything within 2 tiles.

items.name: bomb
items.desc: A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals _X-X damage_ to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.

items.name: firebomb
items.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _X-X damage_ and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.

items.name: flashbang
items.desc: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _X-X damage_ from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.

items.name: frost bomb
items.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _X-X damage_ and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.

items.name: holy bomb
items.desc: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _X-X damage_ from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.

items.name: noisemaker
items.desc: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal _X-X damage_ to anything within 2 tiles!

items.name: regrowth bomb
items.desc: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.

items.name: shrapnel bomb
items.desc: This bomb has been modified with scraps of DM-300's metal, which will fragment and fly everywhere when it explodes, dealing _X-X damage_ in a huge range around the bomb. You had better hide behind something when using it...

items.name: smoke bomb
items.desc: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal _X-X damage_ and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.

items.name: woolly bomb
items.desc: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal _X-X damage_ to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.

items.name: torn alchemy book page
items.desc:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"X"_

items.name: torn guidebook page
items.desc:
A torn page from an adventuring guidebook.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"X"_

items.name: tome of dungeon mastery
items.desc:
An adventurer's guidebook, left here by someone who decided adventuring wasn't for them! This particular book is magical, and can prompt adventurers to read a page at the right moment.

Despite that functionality, the book is most popular because of the big words "Don't Panic!" written in large friendly letters on the cover.

items.name: ceremonial candle
items.desc:
A set of candles, melted down and fused together through use.

Alone they are worthless, but used with other candles in a pattern, they can focus the energy for a summoning ritual.

items.name: corpse dust
items.desc:
The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. But you can feel a malevolent energy lurking within it.

Getting rid of it as soon as possible would be a good idea.

items.name: dark gold ore
items.desc: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.

items.name: dwarf token
items.desc: A strange shaped piece of metal that was being held by a denizen of the dwarven vault. Perhaps it is part of the magic that was binding it to the vault? Best to hold onto it, it might have some use.

items.name: elemental embers
items.desc: Special embers which can only be harvested from young fire elementals. They radiate thermal energy.

items.name: blob of goo
items.desc:
A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.

items.name: obsidian statuette
items.desc: A small jet-black statue carved out of obsidian. It resembles the Imp who sent you down here, it even has their glowing green eyes. There is an inscription on the base of the statue in a language you've never seen before.

items.name: cursed metal shard
items.desc:
A shard of rusted cursed metal, which broke off DM-300 as it was destroyed. You can feel an inactive malevolent magic within it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain scrolls, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.

items.name: pickaxe
items.desc: This is a sturdy and heavy tool for breaking rocks. Tap a dark gold vein in a Caves wall while carrying it to dig the ore out. You don't need to equip the pickaxe to mine with it, but it can probably be equipped as a weapon in a pinch.

items.name: scroll of arsenal
items.desc: The rune on this scroll is a crude drawing of a sword. Reading it aloud conjures a random melee weapon at your feet, already identified and free of any curse.

items.name: scroll of focus
items.desc: Reading this scroll clears your mind. For the next _300 turns_, kills train your weapon proficiency _twice as fast_.

items.name: scroll of identify
items.desc: This scroll permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.

items.name: scroll of lullaby
items.desc: Reading this scroll emits a soothing melody which will lull all who hear it into a deep magical sleep. For the reader and their allies the sleep is restorative.

items.name: scroll of magic mapping
items.desc: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.

items.name: scroll of mending
items.desc: Reading this scroll restores _50% durability_ to your equipped weapon and armor, mending cracks and tears in an instant.

items.name: scroll of mirror image
items.desc: The incantation on this scroll will create two illusory twins of the reader. These mirror images act as weaker clones of the reader, and will chase down their enemies. They have no durability however, and will fade upon taking damage.

items.name: scroll of rage
items.desc: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.

items.name: scroll of recharging
items.desc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will charge up all the user's wands over time when released.

items.name: scroll of remove curse
items.desc: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon, ring, wand, armor, or artifact.

items.name: scroll of retribution
items.desc:
This scroll contains destructive energy which channels the reader's suffering outward into a blast of power. The weaker the reader is, the more damage they will deal. At very low health this scroll can kill most enemies instantly.

Using the scroll takes a toll on the user however, blinding and weakening them.

items.name: scroll of smelting
items.desc: A furnace written on paper. Reading this scroll melts one unequipped weapon or armor down into its material, just like a furnace would, wherever you are.

items.name: scroll of teleportation
items.desc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a different location on the dungeon level. The scroll prioritizes areas the reader hasn't been to before, though it is not able to teleport past locked doors or barricades. It can, however, reveal hidden doors that lead to new areas.

items.name: scroll of terror
items.desc: When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will overwhelm all enemies in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will shorten the effect.

items.name: scroll of transmutation
items.desc: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic. When used on an eligible item it will transform it into a different item of the same type. The magic will even preserve upgrades, enchantments, and glyphs. Scrolls and potions will be transmuted into their exotic equivalent, and vice-versa.

items.name: scroll of anti-magic
items.desc: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.

items.name: scroll of challenge
items.desc:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.

items.name: scroll of divination
items.desc: This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.

items.name: scroll of dread
items.desc:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.

items.name: scroll of enchantment
items.desc: This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.

items.name: scroll of foresight
items.desc: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.

items.name: scroll of metamorphosis
items.desc:
This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.

items.name: scroll of mystical energy
items.desc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.

items.name: scroll of passage
items.desc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.

items.name: scroll of prismatic image
items.desc:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.

items.name: scroll of psionic blast
items.desc:
This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.

items.name: scroll of siren's song
items.desc:
Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.

items.name: stone of aggression
items.desc:
When this stone is thrown at an ally or enemy, all nearby enemies will prefer to attack that character for a short time.

Boss enemies cannot be targeted by this effect directly, but it does work on their minions.

items.name: stone of augmentation
items.desc:
This runestone possesses potent magic which can augment equipment to enhance one property at the cost of another.

Using on a weapon will allow you to enhance either speed or damage. Thrown weapons will also gain or lose durability in proportion with their speed.

Using on armor will allow you to enhance either defense or evasion.

items.name: stone of blast
items.desc: This runestone will instantly explode at the location it is thrown to. Just like a bomb, the explosion will deal damage to anything nearby.

items.name: stone of blink
items.desc: This runestone will teleport the user to the location it is thrown to.

items.name: stone of clairvoyance
items.desc: This stone will instantly reveal all tiles in a very wide area around where it is thrown. Its effect will even reach through walls.

items.name: stone of deep sleep
items.desc: When this stone is thrown at an enemy, it will put them into a deep magical sleep. Magically slept enemies will sleep forever until disturbed.

items.name: stone of detect magic
items.desc: This runestone is able to detect magic affecting an item. Using this stone on an unidentified item will tell you if it is affected by a malevolent curse and whether it is affected by positive magic such as an enchantment or upgrades.

items.name: stone of enchantment
items.desc: This runestone possesses enchanting magic. Unlike an anvil enhancement or umbralite, it will not increase the direct power of an item, but will instead imbue a weapon or armor with an enchantment, granting it a new power.

items.name: stone of fear
items.desc: When this stone is thrown onto a character they will be overwhelmed with terror, and will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing character will shorten the effect.

items.name: stone of flock
items.desc: This runestone summons magical sheep for a short time around the location it is thrown to.

items.name: stone of intuition
items.desc: This runestone holds a weaker version of the magic found in scrolls of identification. Rather than directly identifying an item, it will work on your intuition, allowing you to attempt to identify the type of a potion, scroll, or ring by guessing.

items.name: stone of shock
items.desc: This runestone unleashes a blast of electrical energy which briefly stuns all nearby targets, and grants the thrower wand charge for each target hit.

items.name: spirit bow
items.desc: A bow made out of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled this bow will conjure a magical arrow which can be fired at an enemy.

items.name: annoying
items.desc: Annoying weapons are capable of speech, but they're a bit too energetic. They will often draw attention to you without meaning to.

items.name: dazzling
items.desc: Dazzling weapons will sometimes flash with dazzling light, blinding everything that can see them.

items.name: displacing
items.desc: Displacing weapons are infused with chaotic teleportation magic, possessing the ability to warp enemies around the floor randomly.

items.name: explosive
items.desc: Explosive weapons steadily build up power and explode, damaging anything nearby.

items.name: friendly
items.desc: Friendly weapons are best suited for pacifists, occasionally triggering magic that makes it impossible to fight.

items.name: polarized
items.desc: A polarized weapon is affected by magic that causes its attack to either deal 50% more damage, or no damage at all.

items.name: pressurized
items.desc: Pressurized weapons are capable of erupting with a forceful geyser of water which knocks everything away, including you.

items.name: sacrificial
items.desc: Sacrificial weapons will demand blood from the wearer in return for attacking foes. The more healthy the wearer is, the more blood the curse will take.

items.name: wayward
items.desc: Wayward weapons will sometimes become extremely inaccurate. This magic lasts for a little while when it activates, but can be dispelled by landing a blow with the wayward weapon.

items.name: chaotic
items.desc: Chaotic weapons contain the same wild magic found in cursed wands. There's no telling what will happen when this curse triggers!

items.name: bolas
items.desc: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.
items.stats_desc: This weapon inflicts cripple on its target.

items.name: fishing spear
items.desc: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.

items.name: heavy boomerang
items.desc: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.
items.stats_desc: This weapon circles back to the location it was thrown from after five turns.

items.name: javelin
items.desc: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.

items.name: kunai
items.desc: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.

items.name: shuriken
items.desc: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.
items.stats_desc: Shurikens can be thrown instantly with a 20 turn cooldown.

items.name: throwing axe
items.desc: A heavy throwing axe. It knocks its target back a tile when it hits.

items.name: throwing hammer
items.desc: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.
items.stats_desc: This weapon doesn't stick to enemies and can be collected instantly.

items.name: throwing knife
items.desc: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.

items.name: throwing stone
items.desc: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.

items.name: tomahawk
items.desc: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.
items.stats_desc: This weapon inflicts _X-X bleed_ to its target.

items.name: trident
items.desc: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.

items.name: adrenaline dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will boost the movement and attack speed of allies, or briefly lower the movement speed of enemies. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

items.name: blinding dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.

items.name: chilling dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.

items.name: cleansing dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a mageroyal-based compound which will temporarily make allies immune to all negative effects, or will cleanse positive effects from enemies. Enemies may even briefly forget that they are attacking or fleeing from you. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

items.name: dart
items.desc: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.

items.name: displacing dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.

items.name: healing dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

items.name: holy dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which infuses holy energy into their target. Allies and regular enemies will become blessed, but undead or demonic enemies will take heavy damage. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

items.name: incendiary dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.

items.name: paralytic dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.

items.name: poison dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.

items.name: rot dart
items.desc: These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. Powerful foes will resist most of the effect, but the corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies. These last longer than other tipped darts, but their durability cannot be boosted.

items.name: shocking dart
items.desc: These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.

items.name: blazing
items.desc: This enchantment causes flames to spit forth from a weapon, igniting enemies and dealing bonus damage to enemies that are already aflame.

items.name: blocking
items.desc: Blocking weapons have a chance to briefly shield you after attacking with them.

items.name: blooming
items.desc: Blooming weapons contain magic which will cause vegetation to sprout on or around those struck by them.

items.name: chilling
items.desc: Enemies struck with this enchantment are chilled, slowing their movement and attacks.

items.name: corrupting
items.desc: This powerful enchantment possesses the ability to turn enemies to your will. When an enemy is killed with this weapon, there is a chance they will become corrupted instead of dying.

items.name: crystal
items.desc: This powerful enchantment deals extra magic damage and enhances a weapon's value. However, the enchanted weapon can shatter if the crystals aren't repaired, or given time to self-repair.

items.name: elastic
items.desc: Elastic weapons have a chance to send enemies flying back short distances.

items.name: eldritch
items.desc: Eldritch weapons strike fear into nearby enemies that witness their strikes, causing them to flee from the attacker.

items.name: enduring
items.desc: Enduring weapons knit themselves back together. Every _killing blow restores 5% durability_ to the weapon. Thrown weapons, which are made to wear out, can never be enduring.

items.name: frenzied
items.desc: Frenzied weapons grow fiercer the longer a fight goes on. Each hit in a row on the same enemy deals _10% more damage_, up to +50%. Switching targets resets the frenzy.

items.name: grim
items.desc: This powerful enchantment possesses the power to instantly execute an enemy. The effect is more likely to occur the weaker the enemy is.

items.name: kinetic
items.desc: When an enemy is killed with a kinetic weapon, any excess force is stored in the weapon and will be applied to the next successful attack.

items.name: lucky
items.desc: Enemies which are killed by a lucky weapon have a chance to drop extra loot.

items.name: projecting
items.desc: With this enchantment melee weapons will gain extra reach. Ranged weapons will penetrate walls when aimed at nearby targets.

items.name: shocking
items.desc: Electricity arcs from a shocking weapon, dealing extra damage to all nearby enemies.

items.name: sundering
items.desc: Sundering weapons crack their targets open. Each hit has a chance to make the enemy _vulnerable_, taking 33% more damage for a few turns.

items.name: unstable
items.desc: This enchantment radiates chaotic energy, acting as a different enchantment with each hit.

items.name: vampiric
items.desc: This powerful enchantment leeches life force from enemies with each blow, funneling it back into the wearer. The effect is stronger the lower the wearer's health.

items.name: venomous
items.desc: Venomous weapons inflict a delayed but deadly poison, which becomes more severe each time it is applied.

items.name: vorpal
items.desc: Vorpal weapons are especially deadly, they have a chance to strike so cleanly that they inflict bleed instead of damage to enemies that can bleed.

items.name: assassin's blade
items.desc: A small wavy blade of umbralite, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.

items.name: battle axe
items.desc: The enormous head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.

items.name: bearded axe
items.desc: The long lower "beard" of this axe can hook a leg or a shield.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is fairly accurate, and hits have a _25% chance to cripple_ the target.

items.name: bloodletter
items.desc: A wicked crimson blade that drinks the blood of whatever it cuts. It hits a little softer than a sword, but every strike against an enemy heals you for a fifth of the damage dealt.

items.name: buckler
items.desc: A small round shield held in the fist, made for turning blows aside. It _perfectly parries the first attack from each enemy_.
items.stats_desc: While on your off hand this shield gives _0-X defense_, and it _perfectly parries the first attack from each enemy_.

items.name: crossbow
items.desc: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.
items.stats_desc: This weapon enhances thrown darts to deal _X-X damage_ when it is equipped, and will even grant its enchantment to them.

items.name: cudgel
items.desc: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.

items.name: dagger
items.desc: A simple dagger with a worn wooden handle. Light and quick, it hits hardest on enemies that don't see it coming.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.

items.name: dirk
items.desc: A longer thrusting dagger, it gives a bit more blade to plunge into foes.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is stronger against unaware enemies.

items.name: falchion
items.desc: A heavy single-edged sword with a cleaver-like tip.
items.stats_desc: The _first hit on each enemy deals 40% more damage_.

items.name: flail
items.desc: A spiked ball attached to a handle by a length of chain. Very unwieldy, but devastating if it lands a solid hit.
items.stats_desc:
This is a rather inaccurate weapon.
This weapon cannot surprise attack.

items.name: stone gauntlet
items.desc: This massive gauntlet is made of crimson fabric with thick metal plates layered on top. The fabric tightens around you, making the plates almost like a second skin, and adds tremendous force to your blows.
items.stats_desc: This is a very fast weapon.

items.name: glaive
items.desc: A massive polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.
items.stats_desc:
This is a rather slow weapon.
This weapon has extra reach.

items.name: studded gloves
items.desc: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.
items.stats_desc: This is a very fast weapon.

items.name: greataxe
items.desc: Meant to be wielded over the shoulder, this titanic axe is as powerful as it is heavy.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is incredibly heavy.

items.name: greatshield
items.desc: More like a mobile wall than a shield, this gigantic mass of metal aids defense, but doesn't leave much room for attacking.
items.stats_desc: This weapon blocks 0-X damage. This blocking scales with upgrades.

items.name: greatsword
items.desc: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every swing.

items.name: halberd
items.desc: A long polearm with an axe blade, a spike and a hook at its head.
items.stats_desc: This weapon has _reach 2_, and its axe head cleaves through _40% of the target's armor_.

items.name: hand axe
items.desc: A light axe, most commonly used for felling trees. The wide blade works well against foes as well.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.

items.name: iron-shod staff
items.desc: A thick staff capped with metal. Heavier than a quarterstaff, it guards better but swings slower.
items.stats_desc: When wielding this staff, you get an extra _0-X defense_.

items.name: katana
items.desc: A slender sword with a large metal guard above the handle.
items.stats_desc: This weapon blocks 0-3 damage.

items.name: katar
items.desc: A blade set into an H-shaped grip, driven forward like a punch.
items.stats_desc: This punch-dagger trains the _fist_ family, but it hits hardest on surprise attacks like a dagger.

items.name: khopesh
items.desc: A sickle-shaped sword whose hook can catch and pull away a shield.
items.stats_desc: Its hooked blade drags a guard aside: _elites can't parry it_, and it ignores _30% of the target's armor_.

items.name: kite shield
items.desc: A tall shield, rounded at the top and tapering to a point. It also _blocks part of any magic damage_.
items.stats_desc: While on your off hand this shield gives _0-X defense_, and it also _blocks part of any magic damage_.

items.name: kris
items.desc: The wavy blade of this dagger leaves wounds that are slow to close.
items.stats_desc: Hits have a _30% chance to make the target bleed_. Like other daggers, it hits hardest on surprise attacks.

items.name: kusarigama
items.desc: A sickle on a length of chain, swung to catch an enemy and drag it close.
items.stats_desc: This weapon has _reach 2_, and hits against a distant enemy have a _30% chance to pull it next to you_.

items.name: longsword
items.desc: This sword's long razor-sharp blade shines reassuringly, though its size does make it quite heavy.

items.name: mace
items.desc: The large flanged head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.

items.name: magic tome
items.desc:
A heavy spellbook bound in worn leather, held open in one hand. Its pages hold spells that can be cast again and again, each needing time to recover between casts. It makes a poor club.

Heroes other than the Mage need _magic proficiency 1_ to make sense of it (wand kills train magic). A spare tome can be _deciphered_: for most heroes this takes 10 turns and grants a level of magic proficiency; for the Mage it takes 5 turns, raises _every_ spell his own tome knows by one rank and teaches it one new spell. Every shop stocks a spare tome.
items.stats_desc: Tap the tome to choose a spell to cast.

items.name: maul
items.desc: A two-handed hammer with a head the size of an anvil.
items.stats_desc: The slowest weapon there is, but it hits hardest, and hits have a _30% chance to daze_ the target.

items.name: meteor hammer
items.desc: A weight on a long chain, whirled up to speed before it strikes.
items.stats_desc: This somewhat inaccurate weapon has _reach 2_, and hits have a _30% chance to knock the target back_.

items.name: morning star
items.desc: A heavy club topped with a spiked metal ball.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is fairly accurate, and hits have a _30% chance to make the target bleed_.

items.name: pike
items.desc: A very long spear, best used to keep enemies at a distance.
items.stats_desc: This weapon has _reach 3_, but deals _40% less damage to adjacent enemies_. Hits have a _25% chance to knock the target back_.

items.name: quarterstaff
items.desc: A staff of hardwood, its ends shod with metal.
items.stats_desc: This weapon blocks 0-X damage.

items.name: rapier
items.desc: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.
items.stats_desc: This weapon blocks 0-1 damage.

items.name: round shield
items.desc: This large shield effectively blocks attacks.
items.stats_desc: This weapon blocks 0-X damage. This blocking scales with upgrades.

items.name: runic blade
items.desc: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.
items.stats_desc: This weapon benefits more from upgrades.

items.name: sai
items.desc: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.
items.stats_desc: This is a very fast weapon.

items.name: shortsword
items.desc: A quite short sword, only a few inches longer than a dagger.

items.name: sickle
items.desc: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather inaccurate weapon.

items.name: spear
items.desc: A slender wooden rod tipped with a sharpened metal point.
items.stats_desc:
This is a rather slow weapon.
This weapon has extra reach.

items.name: stiletto
items.desc: A needle-thin blade made to slide between the plates of an armored foe.
items.stats_desc: This is a weak weapon, but it slips past _75% of the target's armor_. Like other daggers, it hits hardest on surprise attacks.

items.name: sword
items.desc: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.

items.name: tiger claws
items.desc: Curved claws worn across the knuckles, made to rake rather than stab.
items.stats_desc: This weapon is fast, and hits have a _35% chance to make the target bleed_.

items.name: war hammer
items.desc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering hammer, though its weight makes every swing slow.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather accurate weapon.

items.name: war scythe
items.desc: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.
items.stats_desc: This is a rather inaccurate weapon.

items.name: whip
items.desc: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.
items.stats_desc: This weapon has tremendous reach.

items.name: forge satchel
items.desc:
A sturdy leather satchel lined with soot-stained canvas. It keeps your ingots, cloth, leather and ore together so they don't crowd your backpack.

Each kind of material takes one slot no matter how many you carry, and it holds up to 12 kinds.

items.name: magical holster
items.desc:
This slim holster is made from some exotic animal hide, and possesses powerful magic which lets it store a massive amount of ranged weapons.

You can simply reach into the bag and will always grab the item you were looking for.

Due to the holster's magic, wands will charge slightly faster and thrown weapons will last slightly longer inside of it.

items.name: potion bandolier
items.desc:
This thick bandolier fits around your chest like a sash, it has many insulated straps on it to hold potion vials, your waterskin, or liquid metal vials.

While inside the bandolier, your potions should be protected from the cold.

items.name: scroll holder
items.desc:
This tubular container looks like it would hold an astronomer's tools and charts, but your scrolls will fit just as well. There's even a few side compartments which would nicely fit spell crystals, arcane styli, and arcane resin.

The holder doesn't look very flammable, so your scrolls should be safe from fire inside it.

items.name: velvet pouch
items.desc: This small velvet pouch can store many small items in it, such as seeds, runestones, and some alchemy ingredients.

items.name: dungeon berry
items.desc: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly, restores a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed!

items.name: blandfruit
items.desc: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.

items.name: chargrilled meat
items.desc: It looks like a decent steak.

items.name: ration of food
items.desc: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.

items.name: frozen carpaccio
items.desc: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's surprisingly good.

items.name: meat pie
items.desc: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.

items.name: mystery meat
items.desc: Eat at your own risk!

items.name: pasty
items.desc: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!

items.name: phantom meat
items.desc: A large glistening translucent steak, cut from a phantom piranha. This magical meat doesn't need to be cooked and grants a number of defensive benefits in addition to fully satiating you. When eaten it will grant invisibility, barkskin, some healing, and cures many harmful effects.

items.name: small food ration
items.desc: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.

items.name: stewed meat
items.desc: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.

items.name: supply ration
items.desc:
This ration was left in the dungeon by and for members of the thieves guild. It's specifically designed to be eaten on the go, and aid with general skullduggery.

While it doesn't fill you up as much as a regular ration, it can be eaten quickly, provides a little direct healing, and will restore a charge to the Rogue's cloak of shadows.

items.name: bow fragment
items.desc: This broken fragment of wood was once part of a lost Huntress' spirit bow. You can still feel a little nature energy left in the fragment, you can use the fragment to grow some high grass around you. Doing this will destroy the fragment however.

items.name: broken hilt
items.desc: This broken hilt looks like it came from a defeated Duelist's weapon. You can still feel a little martial power left in the hilt, you can use it to get a little bonus damage on your next two melee hits. Doing this will destroy the hilt however.

items.name: broken staff
items.desc: This old staff, once carried by a mage who came before you, has been broken in half after its owner met their demise. You can still feel some magical energy left in the staff, you can use it to give your wands a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the staff however.

items.name: scrap of fabric
items.desc: This scrap of translucent fabric looks like it came from a late Rogue's cloak of shadows. You can still feel a little mystical energy left in it, you can use it to give your artifacts a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the fabric however.

items.name: seal shards
items.desc: These tiny shards of red wax look like they came from the seal of a fallen Warrior. You can still feel a bit of willpower clinging to the seal, you can use it to give yourself a bit of shielding. Doing this will destroy the seal shards however.

items.name: torn page
items.desc: This page looks like it was ripped out of an expired Cleric's holy tome. There's still a little divine energy clinging to it, you can use it to regain a little bit of health. Doing this will destroy the torn page however.

items.name: wand of blast wave
items.desc: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.
items.stats_desc: This wand shoots a bolt which violently detonates at a target location. The force of this blast deals _X-X damage_ and is strong enough to send most enemies flying.

items.name: wand of corrosion
items.desc: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.
items.stats_desc: This wand shoots a bolt which explodes into a cloud of highly corrosive gas at a targeted location. Anything caught inside this cloud will take increasing damage over time, starting at _X damage._

items.name: wand of corruption
items.desc: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.
items.stats_desc: This wand will release a blast of corrupting energy which will debuff enemies and eventually bend them to your will. Enemies are able to resist the corruption, but weakened enemies are much easier to corrupt than healthy ones.

items.name: wand of disintegration
items.desc: This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.
items.stats_desc: This wand shoots a beam that pierces any obstacle, and will go farther the more it is upgraded. The beam deals _X-X damage,_ and will also deal bonus damage for each enemy and wall it penetrates.

items.name: wand of fireblast
items.desc: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.
items.stats_desc: This wand blasts out a cone of fire when used. Its next attack will consume _X charges_ and deal _X-X damage._ The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.

items.name: wand of frost
items.desc: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.
items.stats_desc: This wand shoots blasts of icy energy toward your foes, dealing _X-X damage_ and chilling. The effect seems stronger in water. Enemies that are already chilled or frozen take less damage from this wand.

items.name: wand of lightning
items.desc: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.
items.stats_desc: This wand sends powerful lightning arcing through whatever it is shot at, dealing _X-X damage._ This electricity will arc to nearby characters, and spreads more easily in water. The arcs from this wand can damage you, but won't hurt your allies.

items.name: wand of living earth
items.desc: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.
items.stats_desc: This wand sends bolts of magical rock at enemies, dealing _X-X damage._ The rocks will then re-form around the user, granting them armor in proportion to the damage dealt. If enough armor is built, it will form into a rock guardian when the wand is next zapped.

items.name: wand of magic missile
items.desc: This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges and can briefly empower other wands when upgraded.
items.stats_desc: Each bolt from this wand deals _X-X damage,_ and will briefly empower other wands if it is upgraded.

items.name: wand of prismatic light
items.desc: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.
items.stats_desc: This wand shoots rays of light which cut through the darkness of the dungeon, revealing hidden areas and traps. The beam can blind enemies, and deals _X-X damage._ Demonic and undead foes will burn in the bright light of the wand, taking bonus damage.

items.name: wand of regrowth
items.desc: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core. "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"
items.stats_desc: When used, this wand will blast magical regrowth energy outward in a cone, causing grass, roots, and rare plants to spring to life. Its next zap will consume _X charges_. The more charges the wand uses, the larger and stronger the effect.

items.name: wand of transfusion
items.desc: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.
items.stats_desc: When used on allies or charmed enemies, this wand will sap _X of the user's health_ to heal or shield the ally for _X health._ When used on enemies, the wand briefly charms them while applying _X shielding_ to the user. Hostile undead will take _X-X damage_ instead of being charmed.

items.name: wand of warding
items.desc: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.
items.stats_desc: Rather than directly damaging an enemy, this wand will summon stationary wards and sentries. Wards can be summoned anywhere, even through walls if you have vision. This wand can sustain _X energy_ worth of wards at a time.

items.name: ring of accuracy
items.desc: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.

items.name: ring of arcana
items.desc: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.

items.name: ring of elements
items.desc: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.

items.name: ring of energy
items.desc: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.

items.name: ring of evasion
items.desc: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.

items.name: ring of force
items.desc: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.

items.name: ring of furor
items.desc: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.

items.name: ring of haste
items.desc: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.

items.name: ring of might
items.desc: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, putting more force behind every blow and toughening their constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.

items.name: ring of sharpshooting
items.desc: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.

items.name: ring of tenacity
items.desc: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.

items.name: ring of wealth
items.desc: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.

items.name: chaotic censer
items.desc: After some time in the alchemy pot this incense-burning censer appears to be producing smoke all on its own! These gasses build up and will spew forth from the censer toward enemies at semi-random intervals. It seems capable of producing all sorts of gasses, but you'll get a moment of warning just before the censer activates.
items.stats_desc: At its current level, this trinket will spawn a harmful gas near an enemy roughly every _X_ turns. Gasses will only appear when enemies are present. At higher levels these gases are more likely to be exotic and powerful.

items.name: cracked spyglass
items.desc: This handheld telescope would be a demonstration of great and precise workmanship, if it weren't for the crack along its front lens. The spyglass seems to be helping you by revealing new items in the dungeon, but due to its flaw the revealed items are quite hard to see!
items.stats_desc: At its current level, this trinket has a _X%% chance_ to create an extra hidden item on each non-boss floor.

items.name: dimensional sundial
items.desc: This small handheld sundial is somehow able to cast a shadow in the depths of the dungeon, even if you aren't holding it upright. Even more strangely, the shadow's position seems to have no relation to the sun in this world. When no shadow is cast, the sundial seems to attract danger.
items.stats_desc: At its current level, this trinket will reduce the spawning rate of enemies by _X%%_ during the daytime in real life (8am-8pm), and increase the spawning rate of enemies by _X%%_ at nighttime (8pm-8am).

items.name: exotic crystals
items.desc: These small pink crystals have the same shape as crystals of alchemical energy. While they can't be used for energy directly, they seem to be somehow influencing the potions and scrolls you find.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will replace _X%%_ of potion or scroll drops with their exotic equivalents. This does not affect potions of vitality or items that are generated to help solve hazard rooms.

items.name: eye of newt
items.desc: This golden and black newt's eye is a common ingredient, now enhanced into a trinket. The eye seems to be reducing your vision in exchange for letting you see things in other ways.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will reduce your vision range by _X%%_, but will also grant you mind vision on enemies within _X_ tiles.

items.name: ferret tuft
items.desc: A tuft of silky white ferret fur, held together by a Lime green ribbon tied into a bow. Ferrets are known for their agility, mischievousness, and lack of integrity. Some of that power seems to radiate from the trinket, enhancing the evasion of anything nearby.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the evasion of all characters by _X%%_.

items.name: mimic tooth
items.desc: This large sharp tooth must have been pulled from a very unhappy mimic. It seems to be influencing the mimics of the dungeon, making them more frequent and dangerous.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make all kinds of mimic _Xx_ more common and much more difficult to detect, but will also increase the amount of loot they drop. Each dungeon floor will also have a _X%%_ chance to contain an extra stealthy ebony mimic.

items.name: mossy clump
items.desc: This clump of wet moss seems to hold onto its moisture no matter how hard you squeeze it. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making grass and water more likely to appear.
items.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will make _X%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either water or grass instead.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.

items.name: parchment scrap
items.desc: This little scrap of parchment looks like it came from a scroll. It has retained some of its magic, and it seems to be influencing weapons and armor found in the dungeon.
items.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will make enchantments and glyphs _Xx_ as common, and curses on weapons and armor _Xx_ as common. Curses on wands, rings, or artifacts are not affected.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.

items.name: petrified seed
items.desc: This seed has been fossilised, either by slow geological processes or by magic. The seed seems to be magically influencing the flora of the dungeon, occasionally replacing plant seeds with runestones.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will cause trampled grass to drop runestones instead of seeds _X%%_ of the time, and will also cause high grass to drop items _X%%_ more often.

items.name: rat skull
items.desc: This macabre trinket isn't much larger than the skull of a normal rat, which is somehow a rarity down in this dungeon. The skull's magical influence seems to attract the more rare denizens of the dungeon, making them appear far more often.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make rare exotic enemies _Xx_ as likely to appear. The skull is only half as effective at attracting crystal mimics and armored statues, however.

items.name: salt cube
items.desc: This large salt crystal was cut into an almost perfect cube shape, and it somehow managed to drain half the water from the alchemy pot instead of dissolving. It seems to be magically dehydrating and preserving the food you eat, extending the satiety you get, but also lessening your health restoration when not starving.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the amount of time before you grow hungry by _X%%_, but will also reduce your rate of health regeneration by _X%%_ unless the floor is locked.

items.name: shard of oblivion
items.desc: After stewing in the alchemy pot, this small shard of cursed metal has changed to be made of... nothing? Light seems to bend around it, and it hovers in place when you aren't holding it. The shard seems to be magically drawing power from your ignorance, so it's probably best to not think about it too much.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the rate that enemies drop loot by 20%% for each piece of unidentified equipment you have equipped or recently used, to a max of _X item(s)_. The shard will also prevent you from identifying equipment, but can be used to manually identify items that are ready for it.

items.name: thirteen leaf clover
items.desc: Somehow stewing in the alchemy pot has caused this clover to grow a bunch of extra leaves! It's not really clear if this trinket is lucky or unlucky, perhaps this trinket will make your luck more chaotic?
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will cause you to deal maximum damage _X%%_ of the time, and minimum damage _X%%_ of the time.

items.name: trap mechanism
items.desc: The core mechanism of one of the dungeon's pitfall traps, carefully carved out of the floor so it can be carried. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making hazardous terrain more common but also increasing your affinity towards it.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will make _X%%_ of unthemed floors become filled with either traps or chasms instead. Additionally, _X%%_ of the dungeon's hidden traps will instead be visible.

items.name: magical catalyst
items.desc:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.

items.name: vial of blood
items.desc: This thin vial contains the blood of some denizen of the dungeon, it moves slowly as you rotate the vial. It seems to be magically enhancing stronger healing effects, but also delaying them.
items.stats_desc: At its current level this trinket will increase the overall health you gain from drinking potions of healing, waterskins, or wells of health by _X%%_. However, these healing effects will also occur more slowly, regenerating a maximum of _X_ HP per turn (this scales with hero level).

items.name: wondrous resin
items.desc: This shimmering blue resin appears to have the distilled essence of a cursed wand's magic. The magic from the alchemy pot has seemed to stabilize it somewhat, and it's now affecting your wands.
items.stats_desc:
At its current level this trinket will force cursed wand effects to become neutral or positive _X%%_ of the time, and will cause uncursed wands to fire an additional neutral or positive cursed zap _X%%_ of the time.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.

items.name: alchemize
items.desc:
This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into gold or alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!

A few Alchemize uses are sold from shops, but many more can be made using alchemy by combining a seed, runestone, and a little alchemical energy.

items.name: beacon of returning
items.desc: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.

items.name: curse infusion
items.desc:
This spell infuses a piece of equipment with the same powerful malignant magic present within DM-300. The item it is used on will immediately be cursed, and any enchantment or glyph it may have had will be overridden.

In the case of weapons, armor, and wands, the item will gain upgrades in addition to being cursed. Curse infusion upgrades do not stack, and the upgrades are lost if the item becomes uncursed.

Multiple curse infusions can also be used to change the curse on a weapon or armor.

items.name: magical infusion
items.desc:
This spell holds the same power as melding umbralite into an item, but in a more stable form.

In addition to raising an item's level by one as normal, it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.

items.name: phase shift
items.desc: This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect. This spell can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.

items.name: reclaim trap
items.desc:
This spell contains remnants of the mechanical energy of DM-300. When cast on an active trap, the power of the trap will become attached to you, allowing you to use the spell again to expel this power and trigger the trap's effect at any location you like.

However, some traps may not function in all places, and only one trap can be stored at a time.

items.name: recycle
items.desc: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, runestone, or tipped dart into a random item of the same type.

items.name: summon elemental
items.desc: This spell channels the energy of the elemental embers used to make it, and will allow you to summon a friendly elemental to fight with you! Only one elemental can be summoned at a time, but the spell can be re-cast to return the elemental to you at no cost.

items.name: telekinetic grab
items.desc:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.

items.name: unstable spell
items.desc:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.

items.name: wild energy
items.desc: This spell contains some of the cursed energy which powered DM-300. When cast, it will recharge your wands and worn artifacts, while also triggering a random cursed wand effect. You are able to choose a direction for this cursed magic to shoot in, however.

items.name: brigandine
items.desc: Small metal plates riveted inside a cloth vest. Lighter than mail, so it gets in the way less.

items.name: hero's vestments
items.desc: While wearing this mixture of cloth and plate, the Cleric can perform a special ability.

items.name: cloth armor
items.desc: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.

items.name: hero's breastplate
items.desc: While wearing this plate armor and cape, the Duelist can perform a special ability.

items.name: gambeson
items.desc: A thick jacket of quilted padding. It blocks more than a robe, but has none of a robe's lightness.

items.name: half plate
items.desc: A breastplate with shoulder pauldrons. It blocks almost as well as full plate for a lot less weight.

items.name: hero's cloak
items.desc: While wearing this cloak, the Huntress can perform a special ability.

items.name: leather armor
items.desc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.

items.name: hero's robe
items.desc: While wearing this gorgeous robe, the Mage can perform a special ability.

items.name: mail armor
items.desc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.

items.name: plate armor
items.desc: Enormous plates are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection, at the cost of staggering weight. Its material decides how much it blocks.

items.name: hero's garb
items.desc: While wearing this dark garb, the Rogue can perform a special ability.

items.name: scale armor
items.desc: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.

items.name: studded leather
items.desc: Leather armor reinforced with rows of metal rivets. Tougher than plain leather and still no hindrance.

items.name: hero's plate mail
items.desc: While wearing this heavy plated armor, the Warrior can perform a special ability.

items.name: of affection
items.desc: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.

items.name: of anti-magic
items.desc: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's material.

items.name: of brimstone
items.desc: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.

items.name: of camouflage
items.desc: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility.

items.name: of entanglement
items.desc: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage, but this armor will break if the wearer moves.

items.name: of flow
items.desc: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster when moving through it.

items.name: of obfuscation
items.desc: This glyph obscures the wearer, making them more difficult to detect.

items.name: of potential
items.desc: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting charge to the wearer's wand when it activates.

items.name: of repulsion
items.desc: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying back.

items.name: of stone
items.desc: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.

items.name: of swiftness
items.desc: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer whenever they aren't near to an enemy.

items.name: of thorns
items.desc: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.

items.name: of viscosity
items.desc: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly rather than all at once.

items.name: of anti-entropy
items.desc: The Anti-entropy curse works against the forces of the universe, pulling energy into the wearer and away from their surroundings. This briefly sets the wearer on fire, but freezes everything around them!

items.name: of bulk
items.desc: Armor of bulk looks larger and more imposing, but doesn't actually have enhanced defense. Even worse, the added size makes moving into doorways very difficult.

items.name: of corrosion
items.desc: Armor of corrosion is capable of bursting with corrosive fluid, coating everything in the area with sticky acidic ooze.

items.name: of displacement
items.desc: The curse of displacement attempts to move the wearer to safety when they are attacked. It is a bit too effective however, randomly teleporting the user around the level.

items.name: of metabolism
items.desc: The metabolism curse directly converts satiety into health when the wearer is injured, providing a boost of healing, but quickly causing starvation.

items.name: of multiplicity
items.desc: Armor cursed with multiplicity contains dangerous duplication magic. It will sometimes create a mirror image of the wearer, but is equally likely to duplicate the attacker!

items.name: of overgrowth
items.desc: Armor of overgrowth is covered in various blooming plants. While this effect certainly looks interesting, it does nothing for defense, and these plants will randomly activate in combat!

items.name: of stench
items.desc: Armor cursed with stench will release clouds of noxious gas, which is hazardous to everything caught in the cloud.

items.name: Crystal key
items.desc: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?

items.name: golden key
items.desc: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Perhaps it will open a locked chest?

items.name: iron key
items.desc: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?

items.name: worn key
items.desc: This key is worn and discolored, but looks serious. Probably it can open some serious door nearby.

items.name: potion of experience
items.desc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.

items.name: potion of frost
items.desc: The chemical contained in this potion will evaporate into a freezing cloud upon exposure to open air.

items.name: potion of haste
items.desc: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with tremendous energy for a short time, allowing you to run at high speeds.

items.name: potion of healing
items.desc: This elixir will rapidly restore your health and instantly cure many ailments.

items.name: potion of invisibility
items.desc: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

items.name: potion of levitation
items.desc: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over traps and pits. Throwing this potion will create a cloud of unrefined gas, disorienting anything caught in it.

items.name: potion of liquid flame
items.desc: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.

items.name: potion of mind vision
items.desc: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.

items.name: potion of paralytic gas
items.desc: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.

items.name: potion of purity
items.desc: This magical reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful area-bound effects in a large area. Drinking it will give you temporary immunity to such effects.

items.name: potion of vitality
items.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your body, permanently increasing your maximum health by 10.

items.name: potion of toxic gas
items.desc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.

items.name: elixir of aquatic rejuvenation
items.desc: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.

items.name: elixir of arcane armor
items.desc: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.

items.name: elixir of dragon's blood
items.desc: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.

items.name: elixir of feather fall
items.desc: This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.

items.name: elixir of honeyed healing
items.desc:
This elixir combines healing with the sweetness of honey. When drank, it will apply the same effect as a potion of healing and satisfy a small amount of hunger, but it can also be thrown to heal an ally.

Creatures with an affinity for honey might be pacified if this item is used on them.

items.name: elixir of icy touch
items.desc: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.

items.name: elixir of might
items.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your maximum health by 10 and temporarily increasing maximum health by X points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.

items.name: elixir of toxic essence
items.desc: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.

items.name: potion of cleansing
items.desc: This powerful reagent will render the drinker immune to all harmful status effects for a few turns when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.

items.name: potion of corrosive gas
items.desc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas spreads more quickly than toxic gas and is more deadly, but also won't last as long.

items.name: potion of divine inspiration
items.desc:
The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.

items.name: potion of dragon's breath
items.desc: This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva. Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!

items.name: potion of earthen armor
items.desc: Rather than paralyze, this liquid has a hardening effect on the skin which will turn it into temporary natural armor.

items.name: potion of magical sight
items.desc: After drinking this, your senses will be briefly heightened to incredible levels, allowing you to see through walls in a 12 tile radius!

items.name: potion of mastery
items.desc:
This potion attunes the drinker to a single weapon or piece of armor, as if they had spent years caring for it.

The chosen item is _fully repaired_ and from then on _wears down half as fast_. This potion can only be used once on each item.

items.name: potion of shielding
items.desc: Rather than heal, this potion will instead project a durable shield around the user's body, blocking a considerable amount of damage.

items.name: potion of shrouding fog
items.desc: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which quickly spreads and blocks the vision of your enemies.

items.name: potion of snap freeze
items.desc: The chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react with the air, instantly freezing and rooting all within its effect.

items.name: potion of stamina
items.desc: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with a long-lasting boost of energy, allowing you to run at a quickened pace for an extended period of time.

items.name: potion of storm clouds
items.desc: Throwing this potion will create a quickly-spreading cloud of concentrated vapor, which will condense and pour down onto the environment. Most terrain will be converted to water, fiery enemies will take damage, fire will be doused, and traps will be overwhelmed and break.

items.name: aqua brew
items.desc: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.

items.name: blizzard brew
items.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.

items.name: caustic brew
items.desc: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.

items.name: infernal brew
items.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.

items.name: shocking brew
items.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.

items.name: unstable brew
items.desc:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.

items.name: alchemist's toolkit
items.desc: This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.

items.name: cape of thorns
